_about: LumeBook's own results per published carousel, read once 7 days after posting (Instagram Insights + site data). This is the only file that can move a hook formula to lumebook_validated (hook-bank.md, Measurement; research/hook-strategy-2026-10-08.md section 8). Never type an estimate: leave a field null if the number is not available.

_fields.pack_date: the drafts/DATE the option came from
_fields.test_id: the playbook experiment this post belongs to, e.g. N1, or null
_fields.variable_changed: the one hook variable that differs from its comparison post, or null
_fields.non_follower_share: Insights: share of accounts engaged who are not followers, 0 to 1
_fields.cta_comments: comments containing the code word, counted by hand
_fields.preview_visits: site sessions with this carousel's utm_campaign
_fields.purchases: orders attributed by UTM, code word or checkout answer
_fields.account_status_flag: true if Account Status showed a recommendation problem that week
_fields.notes: anything unusual that week: holiday, war news, site outage, a creator shared it, paid boost
_fields.promotion_note: only when proposing lumebook_validated for this formula: the comparison and why it passes the rule
